banner: USD-equivalent backtest — approximate comparison, not actual Israeli fund performance.
notice: These results exclude USD/ILS currency movements and do not reproduce Israeli fund tracking, hedging costs or actual Israeli tax treatment.
amounts: Capital and contributions are USD amounts in this mode. Numbers are preserved without conversion; the same number in USD and ILS represents different capital. Saved portfolios are unchanged.
benchmark: Benchmark: existing USD benchmark of the resolved implementation; portfolios use SPY. Benchmark inception can constrain the window.
backtest_fees: Backtest uses the selected USD tariff ($5/order by default) or your explicitly selected legacy fee settings. Existing tax and rebalancing approximations remain in force.
compare_fees: Compare retains its existing percentage-fee setting; it does not apply Backtest’s flat USD per-order tariff. Compare method and benchmark assumptions can also differ. Match these settings before comparing results across modes.
unsupported: No defensible USD equivalent is configured for {label}. No sleeve was dropped or reweighted.
deep_unsupported: USD equivalents apply to actual-history Backtest and Compare, not bundled Deep History.
no_reconstruction: USD implementations and actual ETF histories are used for the entire tested period. No ILS/USD history splice, FX reconstruction or pre-inception extension.
select_history: Select a strategy or portfolio to resolve USD history.
mixed_history: Mixed USD/ILS portfolios cannot share one research history window.
no_common: Mapped sleeves and benchmark have no common executable history.
